body.heading: Where in the world is Chad?
paragraphs: Chad is a country in Middle Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Chad is N'Djamena.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Chad speak French and Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Chad is the Central African CFA franc. The CFA franc is shared with neighbouring countries, so the same money works across the region.

body.heading: How big is Chad?
paragraphs: Chad covers about 1,284,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Somalia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Zakouma is one of Africa's great conservation success stories — its elephant herds have grown back, and visitors can see lions, giraffes and buffalo on the open plains.
The Ennedi Plateau is a Sahara wonderland of sandstone arches, towers and hidden rock paintings made thousands of years ago.

2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
